widgets_values: A Chinese woman sits on lakeside rocks enjoying a peaceful afternoon. She wears a white inner short dress layered with a loose orange-red knitted cardigan, barefoot, gently holding a few small white flowers up to the side of her face with one hand. A soft breeze blows through her long hair as she gazes into the distance with a relaxed and gentle profile expression. The scene is lit by warm diagonal natural sunlight filtering through thin clouds, creating soft diffused light. The lake surface shimmers with scattered golden reflections and clear ripples. The composition is a medium shot from the waist up, with a background of calm lake water, distant low hills, grassy shore, and rocks. The overall image conveys a warm, peaceful, photorealistic atmosphere, high resolution, rich in detail.
